title: Baby Leo & Friends Learn About Helping Each Other
summary: Today, Baby Leo and his friends discover the joy of helping each other! When a little problem arises during their playtime, each friend comes up with a clever way to lend a hand. Together, they learn that helping makes everything more fun and brings them closer!
lesson: Kids learn the importance of helping each other and working together.

beats.beat: Bella suggests playing a game where they help each other find hidden objects in the park. Everyone cheers for the idea! Baby Leo is curious and keeps asking, 'Why is helping fun?'
